name: Fantasporto
blurb: Porto's long-running international fantastic-film festival, screening horror, sci-fi and fantasy cinema with competitive juried awards.

editions.evidence: Homepage title/text: 'Fantasporto 2027— Call for Entries | 47ª edição • 26 de Fevereiro a 7 de Março 2027 • Batalha Centro de Cinema'.

notes: Fantasporto is a juried film festival, not an autograph-style convention; its site is currently in the 'Call for Entries' phase for the 47th edition and names no jury or visiting-filmmaker guests yet (only links found are past-winner portfolio pages by award category, e.g. 'Prémio Especial do Júri'), so guests is none-yet rather than none — past editions (the homepage's own archive images) have featured guests such as Guillermo del Toro and Wes Anderson.
